name: Zenet Cataract
effectText: Choose a number of your opponent's Main Monster Zones equal to the number of Normal Monsters and "Zenet" Ritual Monsters you control; this turn, the first activated monster effect in each of those zones is negated. If the total ATK of all Normal Monster Cards you control is more than 3000: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; send it to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Zenet Cataract" once per turn.
